documented: Google Chrome documentation identifies a ya29... response value as an OAuth access token and distinguishes it from the refresh token.
Google requires access and refresh tokens to be stored securely; access tokens authorize scoped requests, including tokens issued to public client applications.
Google describes access tokens as opaque. OAuth client identifiers are public identifiers under RFC 6749 section 2.2, not bearer credentials.
assumptions: The case-sensitive ya29. prefix plus at least ten ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen follows pinned TruffleHog v3.97.4 scanner constraints, not a complete provider issuance grammar. No digit requirement, entropy threshold or upper length bound is inferred.

Native word-left and credential-alphabet-right boundaries reject embedded identifiers and truncated candidates before slash, plus, equals or dot. Bare values need no assignment or attribute-name context.

No token decoding, network lookup, expiry, scope, issuance or cryptographic verification is performed. Other Google token prefixes, refresh forms and client secrets are outside this rule, not declared safe.
evidence.fixture_method: Constructed deterministic ASCII candidates from repeated alphanumeric sequences and URL-safe punctuation. Bare, header, JSON, query, minimum-length and low-entropy positives are paired with under-minimum, case, boundary and public-client-ID controls; non-access-token forms are negative only for this rule. No issued token or verifier is used.

documented: Official Pinecone SDK reads PINECONE_API_KEY for authentication.
Current pcsk_ prefix behavior is retained without assignment checks on bare tokens.
assumptions: Legacy UUID shape is a Betterleaks candidate constraint, not a claim of current issuer generation.
No existing positive or negative becomes contradictory: existing UUID negatives are public key/project roles, not PINECONE_API_KEY.
evidence.fixture_method: Independent deterministic synthetic credential bodies in documented private-role carriers; negatives remove the private role, required context or literal framing. No credential was issued or verified online. Runtime verification is reserved for Main.
